Chrononauts fine-tune their devices to glimpse the past and future.

**Temporal Insight:** The chrononaut gains an additional daily use of precision. This ability replaces occult navigator and planar voyager.

**Temporal Talents (Ex):** At 3rd level, 9th level, and 15th level, a chrononaut gains a time thiefGGtTT temporal talent. He adds his aethernaut level to his time thief level for this temporal talent and uses his Intelligence modifier in place of his Charisma modifier for its purposes. He must expend precision rather than motes to use this talent. This ability replaces the discoveries gained at 3rd level, 9th level, and 15th level.

**Aevum (Ex):** At 5th level and again 16th level, a chrononaut gains an aevum from the time thief list. He adds his aethernaut level to his time thief level for this aevum and uses his Intelligence in place of his Charisma for its purposes. This ability replaces the device powers gained at 5th level and 16th level.

**Precognitive Cache (Su):** At 6th level, a chrononaut can prepare a cache of items for future use based upon a warning he receives from his future self. In order to preserve the integrity of the timeline, he psychically isolates this warning from the rest of his memories, only to be unlocked when he reaches the moment at which the warning was sent. As a result, he may carry unspecified equipment worth up to 1,000 gp. This can be any kind of gear that can reasonably fit into a backpack, including potions, scrolls, and nonmagical items of other sorts the aethernaut could reasonably access when packing his cache. As a full-round action, the chrononaut may mentally send the name of an item back in time to when he last prepared his cache and dig through his pockets to retrieve that item, deducting its value from the allocated amount of cost. This item cannot weigh more than 10 pounds. When the total remaining cost reaches 0, the aethernaut can retrieve no more items until he refills his precognitive cache by spending a few hours and an amount of gold to bring his total up to 100 gp per aethernaut level. At 10th level, the cache's maximum value increases to 300 gp per aethernaut level and can include any sort of minor magic item the aethernaut could reasonably access. This ability replaces planar stride and planar guide.
